      Launch chain

      Preferred ecosystem: Robinhood Chain.

      The Flaunchy venue currently selects a live launch chain between Base and Robinhood Chain. Which chain launches is not decided here and is not promised.

      No-wallet / no-gas launch thesis

      The selected Flaunchy path lets the launcher initiate without a wallet, gas, or upfront liquidity. This is a launch thesis under design and does not promise that traders need no wallet or gas.

      Creator fees require trading volume and are not guaranteed revenue. Market cap itself does not produce fees; only realized trading volume does.

      Evidence flywheel

      1. Public hook evidence
      2. → trusted monitoring
      3. → paid capacity / API / adapter work
      4. → bounded contributor bounties
      5. → more verified chains
      6. → more useful evidence

      Creator-fee estimator (estimate only)

      Derived from a 1% total trading fee and an 80% launcher share: estimated launcher fees = cumulative trading volume × 0.008. Denominated in USD-equivalent. Payout would be in ETH per current Flaunchy venue documentation. Results are estimates, not promises.

      Used to compute trading volume; it does not itself produce fees.
